bullets.bullet_text: Implemented SOC 2-aligned AWS controls enabling regulated insurers to safely adopt analytics and ML capabilities, establishing a technical trust foundation for partner-led deployments.
Built an AWS shared-responsibility operating-model framework clarifying insurer-owned versus provider-owned controls, creating a reusable governance pattern for scaling technical partner engagements.
Led AWS modernization execution for monolithic policy administration and insurance platform workloads, translating legacy architecture into production-ready cloud solutions.
